cassettes.title: FELLRIDER
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A moped over the fells, as far as it will go. Pick up the coins and the gas cans.
cassettes.controls:
W A S D: D gas, A brake, W lean back, S lean forward
UP LEFT DOWN RIGHT: the same
SPACE: start

cassettes.title: MUSIC TRACKER
cassettes.author: R.
cassettes.about: A three-voice tracker for the AUNT, the UNC's sound chip, with four tunes on the tape. Press RETURN. Then stop it and write your own.
cassettes.controls:
RETURN: play
SPACE: stop
T: next tune
Z-M: piano, stopped
I: instruments
?: all the keys
cassettes.instructions: Four tunes are on the tape: press RETURN. Then stop it, write your own, and save it to tape with the deck's Rec.

cassettes.title: CLOUDBERRY
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Late summer on the fells. Run and jump across bog, birch wood and stones for cloudberries, to the hut at the end.
cassettes.controls:
A D: run
LEFT RIGHT: or run
SPACE: jump, hold for higher; start

cassettes.title: SALVO
cassettes.author: LAURI
cassettes.about: A battle of tanks, in turns, against the machine. Five tanks a side and five moves a turn: drive, fire, or buy another tank. Collect the coins, mend at the spanners, and leave the enemy with none.
cassettes.controls:
UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT: move the cursor
SPACE: pick a tank; drive to a dotted square; fire at a tank in reverse
N: your next tank
B: buy a tank, $4,000
RETURN: end your turn
cassettes.instructions: Yours are the solid tanks. A turn is five moves, for any of your tanks: a move a square driven (three at most at a time), a move a shot, a move and $4,000 a new tank. A shot reaches three squares if no tank is in the way, and three hits destroy a tank. Drive over a coin for $2,000 and over a spanner to repair. Destroy every enemy tank.

cassettes.title: ORBIT
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Shoot the drifting rocks: a big one splits in two, a small one is gone.
cassettes.controls:
W A D: A D turn, W thrust
UP LEFT RIGHT: the same
SPACE: fire (hold for more), start

cassettes.title: FROSTHALL
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A walk round a hall of timber, stone and ice, in three dimensions, on a 1 MHz processor. The NIECE copies the walls a column at a time and does the sums; the panel counts the pictures a second.
cassettes.controls:
W A S D: W walk on, S walk back, A D turn
UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT: the same
1 2 3: how the walls are worked out
cassettes.instructions: Walk round the hall. 1 casts a ray for every column, 2 for every other column and fills in between (as it starts), 3 draws 40 coarser columns: the panel shows the pictures a second each gets.

cassettes.title: DEEPHOLD
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A small text adventure in UNC BASIC: a cabin, a lamp, a troll, three treasures, and a dark that bites. Two-word commands. It comes with a manual.
cassettes.instructions: Type what you want to do, a word or two, and press RETURN: N, S, E, W, U and D move, HELP lists the words. Find the three treasures under the cabin and lay them in the oak chest. Carry a light. It knows a word by its first three letters. The manual rides on the cassette.

cassettes.title: HIGHRISE
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Stop the sliding row on the tower, fifteen rows up. What overhangs falls off. Take the minor prize at row 11, or go on for the major one.
cassettes.controls:
SPACE: stop the row
RETURN: take the minor prize
cassettes.instructions: A row of blocks slides from side to side: SPACE stops it, and the next starts above, faster. Blocks stay only where there's a block under them, and the next row is as short as what was kept. Miss the tower and the game is over. At row 11, RETURN takes the minor prize, 1,000 points, and starts the next round; SPACE goes on for the major prize at the top, 5,000.

cassettes.title: DEBUG
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Bugs march down the screen in formation. You're the cursor. Fix them.
cassettes.controls:
A D: move
LEFT RIGHT: or move
SPACE: fire (hold for more), start

cassettes.title: SNAKE
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: The classic, on a 40 x 25 text screen. Eat, grow, don't bite yourself.
cassettes.controls:
W A S D: steer, hold two to turn twice
UP LEFT DOWN RIGHT: or steer
SPACE: start

cassettes.title: STACK
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A falling-block puzzle. Trominoes, full rows clear, and every eighth piece is a bomb.
cassettes.controls:
A D: move
W: rotate
S: soft drop
LEFT RIGHT UP DOWN: the same
SPACE: hard drop, start

cassettes.title: SUN
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A house, a sun, a horizon: twenty lines of UNC BASIC on the bitmap. Type LIST to read them.
cassettes.instructions: It draws itself. Then the machine is yours: type LIST to read the program, and change a line.
